data.title: 伊什塔尔 · 星空下的真心话
data.description: 伊什塔尔与你并肩躺在平整的屋顶平台上，指向西方低空明亮的金星。天边的余晖尚未散尽，几颗较亮的星已显现。她难得放轻了声音，说起爱与战争之外那些不擅表达的心事。
data.action: 并肩躺看星空指金星，红瞳柔软低语
data.lighting: 西方地平线残留的暮光与神殿暖灯
data.promptProse: Ishtar reclines in her black-and-gold goddess outfit on the left side of the temple roof, pointing toward Venus low over the western twilight. Her companion with short copper hair lies beside her in a slate-blue travel shirt and watches the point of light she indicates. The wide side view holds both figures in the glow from the temple lamps.
data.animaCaption: Black-haired Ishtar reclines on the left in her gold tiara and points out Venus. On her right, her copper-haired companion in a slate-blue travel shirt follows her hand toward the horizon.
